metrics.theorem: Theorem 3.2 limit (LDA check: TC gap < 1e-10; identical heads under shared statistics)

assertions.description: (A9) shared-statistics LDA check: |TC gap| < 1e-10 (pilot: exactly 0.0 -- identical heads; solver-limited)
assertions.value: gap exactly 0.0 on all 30 (gamma, seed) configs; predictions bit-identical: True

details.note: measured floor is float64 roundoff (~1e-16 scale); the check is solver-limited, precisely the paper's 'attaining the feasibility limit' reading

assertions.description: (A10) independent-estimation arm: head difference ||W_A - W_B||_inf decays ~ n^{-1/2} (the estimation-noise regime printed alongside the bit-exact identity check)
assertions.value: head-diff log-log slope -0.507 over n in [250, 1000, 4000]; mean ||dW||inf 0.1859, 0.0923, 0.0456; error-gap slope -0.070 (flat, see diagnosis)

details.error_gap_note: |err_A - err_B| is second-order flat (slope -0.070): at the Bayes head the error is stationary, so the first-order head noise cancels; the measured error gaps (0.0007, 0.0010, 0.0006) sit at the MC difference floor (~6e-4 at n_eval=1e5). G07's A10 'gap is O(n^{-1/2})' is true in head space, not in error space; drift-recorded.

drift_notes: I01 core.margin imported; using: ['block_loss_matrix', 'e_tc_bound', 'gamma_ij_pairwise', 'gamma_min_population', 'nu_spread_ratio', 'tc_gap'] (local algebra = labeled fallback only).
I02 core.streaming present: SKELETON at I03 run time (EX1-EX5 need no streaming; noted for provenance).

G07-A6 drift: aligned-geometry exact exponent -(1-nu/2)^2/8 is steeper than the interpolating -(1-nu)/8 by nu^2/32, so the stated 0.005 tolerance can only hold for nu <= 0.4 (G07's own pilots imply this); kept as stated with honest FAIL + corrected pointwise ratio assertion.
G07-A8 drift: the doubling bracket's 1.2 slack is smaller than the Gaussian-tail prefactor factor ~2^{-1/4} per doubling; corrected local-exponent bracket gated alongside.
G07-A12 drift: the planted 12-row ladder has THREE rows > 1/2 (0.51, 0.586, 0.73), so the operational count is 9/12, not 10/12 (the 10/12 figure mirrors the paper's real Table 4, L3142).

G07-EX3 pattern: G07's pilot slopes are reproduced exactly by the two-point aligned pattern (C/2 classes at +-s_max); a jittered full-spread pattern adds sibling-class transient contamination up to 0.014 at nu=0.586 over [16,256]. Two-point adopted (deterministic).

EX2/EX3 head-class finding: the per-task softmax-calibrated head has an x-dependent bias (outside ass:ncm-head) and its cross-task confusion does NOT decay with the margin (E_TC -> 1, slope ~ +1e-4); it is run as a labeled extension arm; the in-scope generative CF head attains gap exactly 0 (feasibility limit) -- consistent with Remark on generative methods (L652-663) and Remark 4.5 scoping.
